title: Welcome to OptiShade 1.0!
body:
Thanks for being part of the community. OptiShade is built to make your games look and feel the way you want.

Diagnostics upload privately when you send a report from Troubleshooting, so there is no need to post diagnostic ZIPs publicly. Include the game, GPU and steps that led to an issue.

Known issues: VR frame generation and some long-session performance reports are still being investigated. Shader loading and frame-generation results can vary by game, GPU and driver.

Enjoy the 1.0 release, and thank you for helping improve OptiShade.
